narrative: 一件深色外套待在暗室里，没有轮廓就会消失。逆光（Backlight）在头发、肩膀和帽檐上画出这道边缘，让剪影得以显现。
在雨、尘或烟雾中，同一个后方光源会变成可见的光体，暗示画框之外还有一个世界：探照灯、高窗，或太阳。当你需要的是脸而不是轮廓时，它就不是合适的工具。
如果你为逆光曝光，得到的是剪影（Silhouette）。如果你把它绕到脸颊上，那就变成了侧逆光（Kicker），而不是真正的逆光。
how: 把光源放在主体后方、通常偏上，朝向摄影机方向，用旗板挡住以免炫光，除非你想要那层光雾。硬度可以很硬（阳光、聚光灯泡、探照灯）形成锐利轮廓光边，也可以更软，让头发泛出一层光晕。
色温常常比主光更暖，让边缘读作阳光或钨丝灯效果。悬浮微粒会让光束本身被拍到；没有微粒时，你只会在身体上看到轮廓光边。
提示词：Backlight on [Subject] from behind, rim of light tracing edges, slight veil, separation from background.
when: 用它把一个暗色身影从暗色背景中分离出来，比如一个烟雾弥漫的室内、身后有一扇高窗。不要把它当作一场戏里唯一的光，如果这场戏还需要看清脸的话。
vs: 轮廓光（Rim Light）是逆光在严密遮挡下产生的那道细边高光。侧逆光（Kicker）位于后方偏侧，只亲吻下颌或肩膀，而不是包住整个轮廓。
剪影为明亮的地面曝光，让人物整体变黑。体积光（Volumetric Light）需要雾气，让光束本身可见，而不只是边缘。
发丝光（Hair Light）就是只打在头发上的逆光。
examples_film: 《银翼杀手》（Blade Runner）用探照灯切穿烟雾弥漫的室内，让逆光变成一种建筑元素。《驱魔人》（The Exorcist）在梅林神父到达时，在他身后用了一盏强力的房屋灯。
《天堂之日》（Days of Heaven）和《银翼杀手2049》（Blade Runner 2049）都让阳光或一个强烈的后方硬光源，成为在明亮或多尘背景中托住人物的边缘。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是拍成了剪影，或一道霓虹般的光条。破绽是脸部完全没有曝光，或者是一圈与任何灯具都没有关联的卡通式光环。
解决办法是让主光侧稍微有点曝光，并把这道轮廓光边跟一个真实的后方光源联系起来。

faq.a: 从主体背后朝向摄影机方向打出的光。它用一道边缘把人物分离出来，在有微粒的空气中还能显出一整道光束。

faq.q: 逆光和轮廓光有什么区别？
faq.a: 逆光是方向。轮廓光是当光源被严密遮挡时，这个方向在轮廓边缘画出的那道细高光。
当一个暗色主体本来会和暗色背景融为一体时使用，或者当身后的阳光、窗光应该给人物镀上一圈光晕时使用。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示逆光？
faq.a: 说明灯或太阳在主体身后，指明哪些边缘会被点亮，并说明脸是否保持暗部。只有想要可见光束时才加雾气。

narrative: A dark coat in a dark room disappears without an edge. Backlight draws that edge on hair, shoulders, and hat brim so the cutout reads.

In rain, dust, or smoke the same rear source can turn into volume, implying a world outside the frame: a searchlight, a high window, the sun. It is the wrong tool when you need the face, not the outline.
If you expose for the backlight, you get a silhouette. If you wrap it around to the cheek, you have started a kicker, not a true back.
how: Place the source behind and usually above, aimed toward camera, flagged so it does not flare unless you want veil. Hardness can be hard (sun, PAR, searchlight) for a sharp rim or softer for a glow in hair.
Color is often warmer than the key so the edge reads as sun or tungsten. Suspended particles make the beam itself photograph; without them you only see the rim on the body.
Prompt: Backlight on [Subject] from behind, rim of light tracing edges, slight veil, separation from background.
when: Use it to separate a dark figure from a dark world, as in a smoky interior with one high window behind. Do not use it as the only light on a scene that still needs a face.
vs: Rim light is the thin highlight backlight can produce when tightly flagged. Kicker sits behind and to the side, kissing jaw or shoulder rather than wrapping the whole outline.
Silhouette exposes for the bright ground and lets the figure go black. Volumetric light needs haze so the beam, not just the rim, is visible.
Hair light is backlight aimed only at the hair.
examples_film: Blade Runner cuts searchlights through smoky interiors so backlight becomes architecture. The Exorcist uses a powerful house light behind Merrin as he arrives.
Days of Heaven and Blade Runner 2049 keep the sun or a hard rear source as the edge that holds a figure in a bright or dusty ground.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a silhouette or a neon stroke. The tell is zero facial exposure, or a cartoon ring disconnected from any lamp.
Fix it by exposing a little of the key side and attaching the rim to a real rear source.

faq.a: Light from behind the subject toward the camera. It separates the figure with an edge, and in particles it can show a beam.
Backlight is the direction. Rim light is the narrow highlight that direction can paint on the outline when the source is flagged tight.
Use it when a dark subject would otherwise merge with a dark background, or when a rear sun or window should halo the figure.

faq.q: How do I prompt backlight for AI image or video?
faq.a: Say the lamp or sun is behind the subject, name the edges that catch, and say whether the face stays dark. Add haze only if you want a visible shaft.
